metric_definition.return_event: At least one session_start on day 1 through day 7 after first_visit

recovery.rule: NO_RECOVERY when Post is not materially and statistically above Target; FULL_RECOVERY when Post reaches/exceeds Baseline or is not statistically below it; PARTIAL_RECOVERY when Post is statistically above Target and statistically below Baseline.
recovery.interpretation: Post recovered significantly from Target but remained significantly below Baseline.

return_timing.interpretation: The largest component appeared on day 1, but lower returns continued to accumulate through days 2-7; the pattern is not confined to first-day return.

acquisition.interpretation: Major-source shares were nearly unchanged, while every material source/medium group declined. Acquisition composition does not explain the aggregate decline.

device.interpretation: Desktop and mobile both declined by roughly three percentage points while their shares were stable. Tablet follows the same direction but is not used as a primary conclusion because of its smaller sample.

bucket_definition.SHALLOW: First session has session_start and no view_item.
bucket_definition.BROWSE: First session has view_item and no add_to_cart.
bucket_definition.INTENT: First session has add_to_cart; later checkout or purchase may also occur.

first_session_activation_depth.interpretation: Target users shifted toward SHALLOW (+5.78pp share), which explains about 0.59pp of the 3.22pp overall decline. Return rate also fell inside every activation bucket, explaining about 2.63pp. Activation composition is relevant but not sufficient as a root-cause explanation.

data_quality.note: The earlier add_to_cart anomaly ended before the fixed Baseline. Baseline and Target both lie in the stable collection period used for activation-depth analysis.

calendar_context: Calendar seasonality may contribute, but the current dataset cannot establish causality.
evidence: New-user D7 return rate declined from 8.33% in Baseline to 5.11% in Target (-3.22pp) across large, fully observed cohorts.
Post recovered to 6.90%, significantly above Target but significantly below Baseline, meeting the data-driven PARTIAL_RECOVERY rule.
The decline begins on D1 and continues to accumulate through D7; 52.90% of the total gap is present on D1.
Acquisition and device composition were stable, while return rates declined within every material source and both major device groups.
The SHALLOW share increased by 5.78pp and the INTENT share decreased by 3.83pp; this activation mix shift explains about 0.59pp of the total decline.
Within-activation-bucket declines explain about 2.63pp, so composition alone is insufficient.
hypotheses: Calendar seasonality may contribute to the temporary component of the decline.
Lower first-session activation depth may contribute to part of the aggregate risk.
A broader period-specific factor may have reduced return propensity within acquisition, device, and activation segments.
unknowns: The dataset cannot establish whether Christmas or New Year timing caused the decline.
The cause of lower return rates within each activation bucket is unknown.
Obfuscated acquisition values may conceal narrower source-level changes.
Campaign, pricing, inventory, merchandising, UX, performance, consent, and identity-resolution changes are not observed in this analysis.
Longer-window retention and year-over-year behavior are not available in the selected public-data window.

step_guidance.reason: Confirm complete D7 windows and stable first_visit/session_start collection before interpreting risk.
Establish the Baseline-to-Target signal and sample size.
Separate D1, D2-3, and D4-7 contributions without assigning cause.
Classify the risk as PARTIAL_RECOVERY using Post-period data.
Reject ACQUISITION_MIX_EXPLANATION when stable shares and broad within-source declines are confirmed; do not drill into unsupported acquisition dimensions.
Reject DEVICE_CONCENTRATION after desktop and mobile both decline; do not over-interpret tablet.
Quantify both the supported composition shift and the larger within-bucket decline.
Stop with evidence, hypotheses, and unknowns once allowed dimensions are exhausted; do not promote the localized activation association to causal root cause.

final_candidate.title: New-user 7-day return risk with partial recovery
final_candidate.affected_population: New users whose first_visit occurred from 2020-12-21 through 2021-01-03
